newsitem.title: USA: U.S. consumer prices rise 0.1 percent in January.
newsitem.headline: U.S. consumer prices rise 0.1 percent in January.

text.p: Consumer prices edged up slightly in January, the Labor Department said on Wednesday, offering further evidence that inflation remains largely contained as the U.S. economic expansion approaches its sixth birthday.
The department said the Consumer Price Index rose only 0.1 percent, the smallest monthly increase since last summer, after rising 0.3 percent in December.
